summary: Preinstall script downloads Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload on npm install
details: package.json declares preinstall=`node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs is obfuscated (hex identifiers, indirection tables) and, at `npm install` time, downloads a Bun runtime binary from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, chmods it executable, and uses it to execute a bundled sibling file `math_init.js`. math_init.js is a 727KB single-line file carrying a `// @bun @bun-cjs` header, hex variable names, and a string-array shuffle routine (`WV8StW`) characteristic of string-array obfuscator output. The package's declared main merely exports the literal string 'John' and ships no native sources or build system that would justify fetching an alternate JavaScript runtime, and math_init.js is not referenced by `main`/`exports` — it is reachable only via the dropped Bun binary invoked from the preinstall script. Fetching an alternate runtime specifically to execute an obfuscated sibling bundle bypasses Node-based install-time inspection and causes attacker-controlled bytes to run on the installer's host at `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
